NOTE
**Still not ready — the write-up of #33086 is done, but the screenshots still can't be compared**

New: The description now has a "Relationship to prior work" section on #33086 (what differs, plus the whitespace case). The author says they fixed the `](` + space case and added a test, but the diff since the feedback couldn't be checked. Missing: Matched before/after screenshots of the same input, since there are 4 "before" images and 2 "after" images with no side-by-side pairing. The PR also reimplements #33086 rather than building on its commits, and nothing explains why.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays, and laurynmm can keep guiding the author.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks, the comparison with #33086 helps. The screenshots still can't be compared directly, so please show each input as a matched before/after pair (a table works well), following [the guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots). Please also explain why you're reimplementing instead of building on #33086's commits, per [the guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html).
```
